meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson, Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra, Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Sir John Eliot Gardiner & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
